concept.hr: Write-back je brz dok ne nestane struje; predmemorija s baterijom
concept.en: Write-back is fast until the power fails; battery-backed cache

summary.hr: Piši kroz upravljač s predmemorijom i isključi struju: write-back potvrđuje odmah i gubi prljave blokove, osim s baterijom.
summary.en: Write through a controller cache and cut the power: write-back acknowledges at once and loses dirty blocks, unless it has a battery.
